summary: Agent/JSON batch operations must preserve successful item results when a later Plaud mutation fails.
reason: Plaud batch rename performs sequential remote mutations, so a mid-batch API error can follow already-committed renames. Agents need a partial result envelope to retry only the failed remaining work instead of losing completed item state.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli covers a JSON batch where the first PATCH succeeds and the second returns HTTP 400 while stdout still contains the completed rename.
